status: pre-registered before any category statistic, fit or holdout outcome was computed

relatedButDistinct.sports:minutes-uncertainty-shrinkage: tested (lab-sports-challengers-v2-uncertainty): shrinks toward 0.5 by minutes CV; no availability event
relatedButDistinct.sports:injury-rotation-availability: blocked: needs a licensed timestamped pre-game injury feed; this experiment uses no pre-game injury status

training.role: 2025-26: the only data used to fit the four adjustment numbers

holdout.role: 2026-27 regular season 2026-10-20 to 2026-11-18; outcomes not opened before this protocol and the fitted numbers are committed

availabilityCategories.window: the player's current team's 5 most recent games strictly before the predicted game, counting only games at or after the player's first listed appearance for that team

statusInTeamGame.ABSENT_STATED: row present, did_not_play true, reason non-empty and not COACH'S DECISION (injury, illness, rest, personal, suspension, not with team, any other stated reason)
statusInTeamGame.ABSENT_COACH: row present, did_not_play true, reason COACH'S DECISION
statusInTeamGame.UNLISTED: no row for the player in that team game: unknown, never assumed available or absent

availabilityCategories.RETURNING: status in the team's most recent game is ABSENT_STATED
availabilityCategories.RECENT: not RETURNING, and some game in the window is ABSENT_STATED
availabilityCategories.UNKNOWN: neither of the above, and some game in the window is UNLISTED

adjustment.minutes: expMinutes' = m_c x expMinutes; sdMinutes'^2 = (m_c x sdMinutes)^2 + (s_c x expMinutes)^2
adjustment.distribution: same negative binomial as the baseline: mean = rate x expMinutes', variance = mean + mean^2/k_stat + rate^2 x sdMinutes'^2

fit.data: 2025-26 regular season only (player_box_2026.csv), layer 1 with 2024-25 priors and dispersion fit through 2025-12-31, as in the existing exploratory pipeline
fit.unit: one row per played player-game the baseline scores (points at line 0.5 defines scorability; minutes inputs are the same for every stat)
fit.m_c: mean of r in category c
fit.s_c: sqrt(max(0, variance of r - mean of (sdMinutes / expMinutes)^2)) in category c

lines: proxy lines floor(median of last 10 played) + 0.5 from earlier games only, as in every earlier props study
scores: binary non-tie P(more) = pMore / (pMore + pLess); Brier; log loss (clamped 1e-6); calibration bands [0,0.2,0.35,0.45,0.55,0.65,0.8,1]; ECE over 10 equal-width bins; calibration-in-the-large (mean P(more) minus observed more rate)

uncertainty.method: paired bootstrap resampling whole games (ESPN game id)

primary: holdout, adjusted lines (RETURNING and RECENT) pooled across points, rebounds and assists: full variant minus baseline

decisionRule.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: fewer than 150 adjusted holdout lines or fewer than 30 distinct games
decisionRule.IMPROVES: Brier difference upper 95% < 0 AND log-loss difference point estimate < 0
decisionRule.note: The ablation, per-category, per-stat, all-lines and exploratory results are descriptive and cannot change the verdict. Nothing is promoted by any verdict.

exploratory: 2025-26 chronological split, previously inspected season: fit the four numbers on games through 2026-01-31, score 2026-02-01 to the end of the regular season. Descriptive only.
notUsed: pre-game injury reports (not collected; see the rules document)
teammate availability (unknown before tip-off without a pre-game report)
